name: Pelham Claw-Guard Wide Runner
description: A running shoe with a dramatically widened toe box — almost twice standard width — and reinforced toe cap channels that create individual lanes for clawed toes without restricting them. The upper is a breathable mesh-synthetic blend with a structured midfoot. It looks like a chunky athletic shoe from the heel, normal from the side, and distinctly wide and blunt at the front. Tier 2-3 geneware users who want to actually exercise with claw-foot mods without destroying standard footwear inside a month.
functionality: Wide-last construction with individual claw-channel toe cap. Reinforced upper resists tearing from claw protrusion under lateral stress.
what_it_says: You're active, you're practical, and you got the geneware for function not aesthetics — or both.
worn_by: geneware users who need athletic footwear
story_hooks: Pelham is the only athletic brand making claw-compatible runners at this price point — a corponation buyout offer is on the table and the community is watching.
A pair was found with the claw channels deliberately reinforced with a filed-down blade — someone was using them as a weapon.
